status: Native Windows implementation with automated core/workbook and DOM tests; interactive end-to-end validation still required
technology: C# / .NET 10 with a thin WPF shell and WebView2 UI; Windows events and Excel operations remain in C#

settings.location: Modal opened from the top-right Settings button; no sidebar
settings.editing: Draft changes; Save applies, Cancel or Escape discards

acceptedUx.workSegments: Always visible on each daily card with label Munkaszakaszok:; recompute immediately after lunch changes
acceptedUx.dayStatus: Distinguish ongoing, complete and incomplete days; exclude ongoing and incomplete days from automatic append
acceptedUx.singleValueCopy: Click selects the complete value; copying shows brief non-modal feedback. Values align right and copy icons sit close to the text.
acceptedUx.disabledLoggingWarning: When Windows logging is OFF, show a prominent top warning explaining that new lock/unlock events cannot be tracked. Clicking opens the Time rules settings tab; support Hungarian and English.
acceptedUx.readPermissions: Startup and refresh never elevate. Missing Security-log access shows saved data and a warning. An explicit Time rules action can request UAC to delegate only account read access to Security and audit-policy queries; disclose the full-log scope. Unknown policy status is not treated as disabled.
acceptedUx.nativeCaption: Native Windows titlebar follows the chosen theme, including live preview and Cancel restoration; Auto follows OS changes and high contrast keeps system colors.
acceptedUx.lunchUndo: Immediate manual pair selection with Undo and return to automatic estimate
acceptedUx.pendingCounts: Show pending day count, new row count and unfinished existing row count beside Excel actions
acceptedUx.rememberView: Remember font size, native window bounds, expanded days and scroll position; refresh preserves the view
acceptedUx.previewLimit: Prototype uses sample data and simulates logging/file actions; native window bounds are an implementation requirement

date.uiAndClipboardFormat: Follow the selected workbook's Details date format and Windows regional separators
date.excelNumberFormat: Preserve or inherit existing target cell/row/column formats
date.excelStorage: Numeric date values, preserving the existing workbook structure

time.uiFormat: Follow Details From/To formats, including leading-zero and seconds rules
time.uiRounding: No rounding for display: 08:01:37 displays as 8:01 under h:mm, matching Excel
time.largeValueCopyIcon: A separate copy icon next to the large date and each large time, including both lunch endpoints. Date copies in the workbook date format; time copies original HH:mm:ss. Direct text selection copies the displayed Excel-formatted value.
time.automaticDetailsAppend: Preserve source seconds in numeric Excel time values
time.calculations: Use original timestamps, never formatted display text

selection.nativeControl: Read-only text inputs for displayed values and editable inputs for settings, hosted in WebView2
selection.pasteScope: Editable settings only; recorded event data remains read-only
selection.dayExpansion: Separate arrow button so selecting a date cannot expand or collapse the day
selection.singleWorkSegment: Copy icon beside every work segment: one headerless TSV row with Date, From and To, preserving seconds. Enabled for finished segments, including finished segments of the current day; unfinished segment copy is disabled.

dailyWorkSegments.format: Headerless TSV with CRLF rows, workbook-formatted dates and exact HH:mm:ss times; paste into Details A-C
dailyWorkSegments.rows: One row per work section, using the same lunch and split-break rules as Details append
dailyWorkSegments.availability: Complete, closed days only; ongoing or incomplete days have no final work-segment export

existingRules.activityTracking: Optional unelevated session collector. Setup registers automatic startup independently of the main UI. Disabled collectors exit without sampling. About one-second samples, lock-time snapshots, separate local journals and health status.
existingRules.activityTimeSource: Select lock or last input for display, lunch, splitting, copy and Details append. Preserve raw events and manual lunch IDs; use the lock time with a visible fallback when no valid observation is available.
existingRules.splitRule: Only breaks strictly longer than the configured threshold split work rows; shorter breaks count as work
existingRules.manualLunch: A chosen complete lock/unlock pair always gets excluded from work time, even below the split threshold
existingRules.preserveManualLunch: Changes to automatic lunch parameters do not overwrite a manual choice
existingRules.detailsAppend: Append days after the last existing date and separately offer completion of an unfinished existing row in preview
